title: Finite support of finitely generated etale subsheaves
statement: For a separably closed field K, a finite-type K-scheme X, an abelian etale sheaf F supported on closed points, and a finitely generated etale subsheaf G, the support of G is finite and consists of closed points; with its reduced closed subscheme structure i:Z to X, G is isomorphic to the direct image of its restriction along i.

proof.text: Geometric stalk functors preserve monomorphisms, so support of a subsheaf is contained in support of F. Outside that support the pullback of F to any separably closed geometric point is zero: the algebraic-closure points jointly detect zero objects, and pullback commutes with their stalks [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar]. Consequently every point of the nonvanishing locus of a section on an etale chart maps into support of F.

An affine etale chart is Noetherian since it is locally of finite type over the base field. The nonvanishing locus of a section is closed upstairs. Mathlib IsClosed.exists_finite_forall_exists_specializes gives finitely many points in it such that every point is a specialization of one of these. Their images are in support of F and hence are closed. Continuity preserves specialization, so every image point equals one of their finitely many images. This gives a finite set of closed image points for each generator.

Let T be the finite union of these finite sets, and U its open complement. Each generator vanishes on U, so the restriction-unit kills it. The source-library kernel supportedIn F U contains every generator; by the least-subobject definition it contains G. Its restriction to U is zero, and exact inverse image makes the restriction of G zero too. Lifting geometric points in U and comparing stalks shows support G is contained in T. It consists of closed points by the support inclusion, so it is finite and closed. Form its concrete reduced subscheme via IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal. The closed-immersion essential-image theorem [lem-kun-04ca] puts G in the image of direct image. The invertible counit and unit naturality make the unit at G invertible, yielding G isomorphic to i_* i^* G. The argument also covers the empty generator family and empty support.

lean.statement:
theorem closedPointSheaf_finitelyGenerated_finiteSupport
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [IsSepClosed K] (X : Scheme.{v})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (hF : etaleSheafSupport F ⊆ {x | IsClosed ({x} : Set X)}) :
    ∀ G : Subobject F, IsFinitelyGeneratedEtaleSubsheaf G →
      (etaleSheafSupport (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})).Finite ∧
      etaleSheafSupport (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ⊆
        {x | IsClosed ({x} : Set X)} ∧
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{v}) (i : Z ⟶ X) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i) (_ : IsReduced Z),
        Set.range i.base =
          etaleSheafSupport (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ∧
        Nonempty ((G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ≅
          (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} i).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} i).obj
              (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})))
